name: Cheese And Caramel Popcorn
ingredients_raw: Caramel Popcorn: Sugar, Corn (33%), Butter, Edible Vegetable Oil (Rice Bran Oil), Liquid Glucose, Maltodextrin, Mineral Salt, Emulsifier (INS 322 & INS 471), Raising Agent (INS 500(ii)), Rosemary Extract (INS 392). Cheese Popcorn: Corn (60%), Edible Vegetable Oil (Rice Bran Oil), Cheese, Milk Solids, Maltodextrin, Mineral Salt, Emulsifier (INS 331 & INS 452), Rosemary Extract (INS 392). Contains permitted natural colours (INS 160b) and added flavours (natural and nature identical flavouring substances - caramel, cream & cheese)
